Uses only same-year non-focal structural peers in the preregistered five-feature M11 space; k and favorable-neighbor rule are locked before frontier outputs are inspected.
Uses M7 national province cross-fitted residuals and the pre-existing West Sumatra full holdout to construct a conditional favorable 2024 reference for real GRDP per capita.

M11 predictors are structural characteristics rather than defensible controllable resource inputs; poverty and unemployment are undesirable outcomes rather than straightforward production outputs. A DEA efficiency score would impose semantics the current evidence does not support.

The short 19-geography panel and mixed social/economic outcomes do not justify imposing one common half-normal one-sided inefficiency process in M12 v1. SFA may be reconsidered for a future production-specific specification with qualified input/output semantics.

A conditional quantile model is conceptually relevant but would add a second parametric fitting layer to a small panel. M12 v1 first establishes transparent residual-quantile and structural-neighbor references that can be audited directly from M11 outputs.
